blocks.hero.subhead: Reaching out is often the hardest part. Tell us a little about what's going on, and we'll help you take the next step. Most people are seen the same week.
blocks.request.heading: Request an appointment
blocks.office.heading: Prefer to call?
blocks.next.heading: What happens after you reach out

next.steps.title: We help you choose
next.steps.text: Our office administrator listens to what you're looking for and suggests the counselor who fits best, or books you with the counselor you picked.

next.steps.title: Your first session
next.steps.text: Usually the same week, in our office or online, 50 minutes. Your first session is mostly a conversation, with nothing to prepare.

blocks.note.heading: When another kind of care fits better
blocks.note.body: Freedom doesn't provide psychiatric care or medication management. If that's what you need, or if you're reaching out for a child under 8, we'll still help you find the right next step.
